text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to copy human intelligence. Instead of following only fixed instructions, AI systems can learn from data and make decisions. Machine learning is a key part of AI: computers improve their performance by studying examples. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses large artificial neural networks to solve complex tasks like image and speech recognition. AI is already part of daily life. It helps us unlock phones with our faces, get movie recommendations, translate languages, and use voice assistants such as Siri. Banks also use it to detect fraud. AI is changing the way we live and work.
